vision.content: A brass diving bell suspended over a harbour at dusk, its rivets catching the last of the light while three figures in oilskins pay out the cable from a stone quay.
I cannot describe this image, as it appears to depict an identifiable person.
A daguerreotype portrait of a woman in a high collar, one gloved hand resting on a barometer, the plate scratched along its lower edge.
An orrery of hammered copper, its planets frozen mid-orbit above a lacquered case whose drawers stand a hand's width open.
A vertical close-up of a small tabby kitten with large round amber eyes, the background falling away into soft bokeh, no watermark anywhere on the plate.
